wells.rule: a tip inside the ink well's circle and below the ink surface loads ink (a steel point has no other state); the pen starts dry

truth.notice: The exemplar was made by robot-coding-bench (RoboPaint) on 2026-10-09 from a public-domain scan (George Bickham, The Universal Penman, 1741; Getty Research Institute via the Internet Archive): the lettering was cropped, its ink re-drawn with the task's pointed pen (the pen's path and the spread of its tines at every point), divided into regions along its strokes and placed on the sheet; the picture (target.png) is the pen's rendering of it.
